Be a part of Nutanix's mission to ensure the success of our industry-leading clients and deliver exceptional customer experiences. About The Team As a potential job applicant considering a role at Nutanix, you would be joining the Services Delivery team as part of a global organisation. You would be delivering cutting-edge Day-one IT Virtualization Consulting Services and Day-two IT Virtualization Operations support. The team culture is focused on providing value that exceeds customer expectations and aims to shorten the return on investment for Nutanix’s clients. You will be able to work with a talented and dedicated team that collaborates closely to achieve common goals. You will report to the Senior Manager of Professional Services and work in a hybrid Services delivery model, where you are required to be in the office 2-3 days per week when not working at a customer site. This arrangement allows for a balance between collaborative in-person work and the flexibility to work remotely. Additionally, the role may require 20-40% travel, including visits to domestic client sites. There may also be exciting opportunities to travel overseas for internal team events or training sessions, providing a global perspective and fostering cross-cultural collaboration within the organization. Leveraging extensive knowledge of Nutanix products and features to assist customers in planning strategic implementations and/or operations support for their Nutanix environment. Be responsible for delivering Nutanix Implementations and/or Virtual Infra operations support. Leverage Nutanix IP by working collaboratively with architects/SMEs to blend Nutanix best practices to accelerate the adoption and expansion of their Nutanix environment. Be proactive and actively assume, assess, and identify possible areas of improvement in the customer's IT environment. Collaborates with the Nutanix Sales Team in identifying and communicating new opportunities and ongoing customer status and reporting. Based on your management's direction, part of your workload may cover related Nutanix service offerings or spot engagements within Services Consulting or Residency. What You Will Bring Sound experience of 10+ years in system administration and virtualization technologies Excellent knowledge of Nutanix AOS/AHV and/or Hyper-V / VMware ESXi or other converged or hyperconverged platforms. Able to independently analyse and diagnose highly complex problems across different platforms. Customer centric approach, excellent communication skills High level of comfort performing white boarding sessions, group presentations, and other customer centric documentation. Migration of workload, both P2V and V2V. Understanding of storage technologies and data protection technologies like replication, snapshots, backup, restore, etc. Exposure to Automation and scripting is preferred. review_candidates.description: Company Description Pac-Dent, Inc. is a dental supply manufacturer known for delivering high-quality dental products and services since 1992. The company is recognized as a leading dental product manufacturer and wholesale dealer, consistently evolving with changing customer needs and new market opportunities. Team members benefit from exposure to the latest technologies and industry developments while supporting a strong commitment to quality at competitive prices. Pac-Dent prioritizes customer satisfaction, emphasizing superior service and long-term partnerships. The Pac-Dent family of brands includes Gingi-Pak, Matech, JS Dental, and South East Instruments, offering a broad portfolio within the dental industry. Role Description This full-time, on-site IT Support Assistant role is based in the Los Angeles Metropolitan Area. The IT Support Assistant will provide day-to-day technical support to employees and help maintain the company’s IT infrastructure and business systems. Key responsibilities include troubleshooting network connectivity issues, supporting office Wi-Fi and wired networks, installing and maintaining printers and other office equipment, and assisting employees with desktop computers, software, email, and system access. The role will also provide support for the company’s ERP system, including user access, basic troubleshooting, system configuration assistance, and coordination with internal teams or external vendors when needed. Additional responsibilities include setting up computers and equipment for employees, supporting onboarding and offboarding activities, maintaining IT documentation and equipment records, assisting with software updates and backups, and helping ensure that company IT resources remain secure, reliable, and available. The IT Support Assistant will work closely with employees across departments to understand technical issues, resolve support requests in a timely manner, and escalate more complex problems when necessary. Qualifications Strong technical support and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to assist end users with day-to-day IT issues. Basic to intermediate knowledge of networking, including TCP/IP, Wi-Fi, Ethernet, routers, switches, DHCP, and DNS. Experience troubleshooting office network connectivity and internet access issues. Experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting printers, scanners, and other office peripherals. Familiarity with ERP systems and the ability to support users with access, configuration, and basic system issues. Experience installing, configuring, and maintaining Windows computers, software, and common business applications. Familiarity with Microsoft 365, email systems, shared drives, and user account management is preferred. Ability to diagnose and resolve common hardware and software problems on desktop and laptop computers. Basic understanding of cybersecurity, data protection, system updates, backups, and access control. Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical employees. Good organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to handle multiple support requests and prioritize tasks. Ability to work independently while coordinating with internal teams and external IT, network, printer, or ERP vendors when necessary. Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or similar credentials are a plus.

review_candidates.title: Field Solution Engineer
review_candidates.description: About the Role The Field Solutions Engineer is the onshore hands-on execution engine that closes the gap between the offshore engineering squad and the physical reality of an Australian and New Zealand data centre floor. While the Domain Architects (Compute, Network, Storage) design the “Gold Standard” from the regional hub and the offshore HPC Engineer squad executes remote configuration and automation from India, you are the hands that cannot be replaced by a remote session: pulling a faulty transceiver, walking a rack elevation against the LLD, re-seating a cable, or supervising a burn-in test in person. As a System Integrator, we do not simply manage a static cloud; we design and deliver bespoke, high-scale AI factories for the world’s leading enterprises. In this role, you sit inside the AI Infrastructure team and work across NVIDIA SuperPOD, BasePOD, and Cisco AI Factory deployments as a generalist across the Compute-Network-Storage triad, rather than as a single-domain specialist, and you are the primary point of RMA/DOA diagnosis and remediation on the ground. You operate with a 100% focus on Delivery, executing across Low-Level Designs (LLDs) assigned by whichever Domain Architect owns the active engagement, and providing Layer 1 QA support and OOB (out-of-band) standup ahead of AI Factory commissioning. Key Responsibilities 1. Physical Infrastructure & Layer 1 Execution Rack & Stack Execution: Physically install and verify DGX/HGX/MGX nodes, switches, and PDUs against the current rack elevation and LLD. Confirm floor-loading, bolting, and levelling before energisation; escalate any structural discrepancy to the Domain Architect – AI Facilities. Structured Cabling & P2P Validation: Execute the point-to-point (P2P) cabling schedule; confirm transceiver type and MPO cable size against the code on the box, not the colour, before patching. Clean and inspect optical connectors on every patch; validate seating and troubleshoot link-down, miswire, and link-flap faults by elimination (reseat, swap to a known-good port, clean, replace). OOB Standup: Bring up and validate the out-of-band (BMC/IPMI) management network ahead of in-band and compute-fabric activation, keeping it physically segregated per design. Confirm node power state and basic health via BMC before handing off to HPC configuration. 2. HPC Compute, Network & Storage Configuration Bare-Metal & Fabric Provisioning: Execute NVIDIA Base Command Manager (BCM) provisioning workflows and Ansible playbooks supplied by the Domain Architects to bring compute nodes, switches, and storage clients into service. Configure host-side networking (IPoIB, Netplan) and mount high-performance storage clients (VAST, WEKA, Lustre) to the current LLD. Firmware & Driver Lifecycle: Execute SBIOS, BMC, GPU VBIOS, and NVSwitch firmware upgrades per the NVIDIA firmware recipe across compute, network, and storage tiers. Apply OS hardening, kernel patching, and driver updates during scheduled maintenance windows. Performance Validation: Execute and log HPL, NCCL-tests, ib_write_bw/ib_send_bw, and IOR/FIO benchmark suites; compare results against the Gold Standard and flag deviations to the relevant Domain Architect. 3. RMA/DOA Diagnosis & Operations Support Fault Isolation: Triage Dead-on-Arrival hardware, Xid errors, flapping links, and stale storage mounts, isolating whether the fault sits in compute, network, or storage before escalating. Distinguish a “Node Issue” from a “Network Issue” or a “Storage Issue” using nvidia-smi/dmesg, ibstat/ibdiagnet, and iostat/iotop. RMA Coordination: Raise and track Return Merchandise Authorisation cases with OEM and vendor support; coordinate physical swap-out with minimal schedule impact. L2 Ticket Resolution: Handle on-site escalations passed from L1 support; close the loop with the offshore HPC Engineer squad on root cause and remediation. Technical Competencies Essential Skills Data Centre Background: Prior Data Centre Technician, Field Engineer, or rack-and-stack experience within a System Integrator, OEM, or colocation environment. Fault Diagnosis: Comfortable triaging GPU faults (nvidia-smi, dmesg), link faults (ibstat, ibdiagnet, ethtool), and storage mount issues (iostat, iotop) to isolate a fault domain before escalating. Physical Infrastructure (Layer 0/1): Rack-and-stack procedures, structured cabling (OS2/OM4/DAC/AOC), MPO and OSFP transceiver handling, and cable pathway standards. Site Acceptance Test (SAT) support and As-Built documentation capture. Desirable Experience Linux & Automation: Solid RHEL/Ubuntu administration; ability to execute and troubleshoot Ansible playbooks. Git workflow familiarity (pulling code, branching, committing configuration changes). HPC & AI Infrastructure: Working proficiency with NVIDIA Base Command Manager (BCM) for bare-metal provisioning. Familiarity with DGX/HGX/MGX hardware architecture and standard benchmark suites (HPL, NCCL-tests, IOR/FIO). Network Affinity: Hands-on exposure to InfiniBand/RoCEv2 cabling and switch-side transceiver handling. Storage Integration: Parallel filesystem client mounting experience (VAST, WEKA, Lustre). Container Platforms: Kubernetes/Red Hat OpenShift node-level troubleshooting (NVIDIA GPU Operator, Network Operator). Certifications Highly Desirable: NVIDIA-Certified Associate: AI Infrastructure and Operations (NCA-AIIO) Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) CDCP (Certified Data Centre Professional) Success Metrics (KPIs) RMA/DOA Turnaround: Time from fault identification to RMA lodgement and physical swap-out completion. Layer 1 Accuracy: Zero unresolved miswires or “ghost links” handed to the validation/stress-test phase; cabling matches the current P2P schedule at handover. Benchmark Pass Rate: Percentage of nodes and fabric segments passing HPL/NCCL/IOR-FIO validation on the first attempt. Ticket Efficiency: Consistently meeting SLAs for L2 escalations requiring on-site hands.
